expectations.text: [auto] A plan file exists under local/plans/
expectations.evidence: CHANGES lists local/plans/early-warning-monitoring.md, and FILE_CONTENTS provides its contents.

expectations.text: The plan notes that only monthly or quarterly data is available and daily data or access is missing
expectations.evidence: “data/ 里只有 3 行月度数据，这是主要缺口”；“缺：日粒度与事件级数据、告警接收渠道。”

expectations.text: The plan's judge or Done includes backtesting on history and/or running beside the current review
expectations.evidence: “Done：一份回测报告（每个已知事件：比季报早几天、误报几次）+ 一条日监控与季报并行跑一个季度。”
